svg.title: npm run demo · offline, a fake production on 127.0.0.1
svg.desc: seamkit's offline demo. Production serves pr#17 and a readback records what is live as an event on seamkit/state. Production is rolled back to pr#14 and the next readback reports three changes NOT LIVE: seen live in that recorded event, absent now. Replay then recomputes both recorded verdicts.
